title: Settlement Account
subtitle: What a branch must hand over (shortage · عجز) or may keep back (surplus · فائض), and what a till has already taken against it.

access.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the grant for the settlement account. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so this screen stays closed. Try again in a moment.

search.label: Find a branch
search.placeholder: Branch code, or name in either script
search.empty: No branch matches that. Try a code, or part of a name in either script.

errors.fleetFailed: The estate could not be loaded, so search and the ageing count are unavailable.
errors.worklistFailed: The worklist could not be loaded.

signpost.title: Still open across the estate
signpost.hint: Entries nobody has settled yet, oldest first. Open the list to work down it.
signpost.failed: The estate’s open position could not be read, so these counts are unknown: {{detail}} This is not “nothing to chase” — try again, and tell head office if it keeps happening.
signpost.capped: This reached {{limit}} entries, so there may be more open than these counts say.

worklist.title: What needs a human
worklist.estateWide: Wrong money and waiting cash are shown for the whole estate, whichever branches are scoped.
worklist.nothing: Nothing needs a human right now. No consumption is missing its document and no prepared receipt is waiting.

wrongMoney.title: Wrong money ({{count}})
wrongMoney.hint: A till took money against an entry and the document behind it never arrived.
wrongMoney.row: consumed {{at}}, with no document behind it

repair.title: Repair this consumption
repair.summary: Put {{amount}} back onto its entry at branch {{store}}.
repair.raceHint: If a document has arrived since this list was drawn, the repair does nothing at all — which is the right outcome, and you will be told.
repair.reasonHint: Up to 200 characters. This is kept beside the repair in the branch's history.
repair.done: {{amount}} is back on the entry at {{store}}.
repair.noOp: A document arrived for this consumption — nothing to repair.
repair.refused: The server would not repair this consumption.
repair.failed: The repair could not be sent.

account.empty: No settlement entry has ever been posted against this branch. That is the ordinary state for most of the estate, not a failed lookup.
account.capReached: This account came back with {{limit}} entries, which is the most the server will send. There may be more that are not shown here.

errors.loadFailed: This branch's account could not be loaded.

position.owes: shortage — to be handed over to head office
position.keeps: surplus — may be kept back by this branch

headline.notActionable: The position is shown, never settled. A till consumes one entry, of one kind, through one document — a shortage and a surplus never cancel each other out.
headline.pending_one: 1 entry waits for a supervisor’s approval. It is in none of the figures above, and no till can see it yet.
headline.pending_other: {{count}} entries wait for a supervisor’s approval. They are in none of the figures above, and no till can see them yet.
headline.theft_one: 1 approved theft is on this account. It moves no cash, and it is in none of the figures above.
headline.theft_other: {{count}} approved thefts are on this account. They move no cash, and they are in none of the figures above.

journal.title: What a till has taken against this entry
journal.noSelection: Pick an entry above to read its journal.
journal.empty: No till has taken anything against this entry yet.
journal.emptyCancelled: Nothing was ever taken against this entry — which is why it could be cancelled outright rather than written off.
journal.writtenOff: {{amount}} of the remainder was written off by {{by}} on {{at}}. The journal below is unchanged by that — a write-off touches no consumption.

document.orphan: No document — the close never completed
document.orphanHint: The receipt number is stamped on after the fact, so a blank one means the close is either seconds old or it timed out and gave up. If it stays blank, this is money the branch handed over against a document that will never exist.

journal.emptyPending: No till can see this entry until a supervisor approves it, so nothing has been taken against it.
journal.emptyRejected: A supervisor rejected this entry before any till could see it, so nothing was ever taken against it.
journal.emptyTheft: A theft moves no cash, so no till takes anything against this entry. It names business day {{day}}.
journal.emptyTheftNoDay: A theft moves no cash, so no till takes anything against this entry.

correction.title: Correcting a mistake
correction.noAmend: Changing the amount is not offered at all here. Once posted, an entry is either withdrawn whole while nothing has been taken against it, or its remainder written off once a till has taken part of it — and both are an accountant supervisor's acts. A wrong amount or Description is asked for as a change request, above; otherwise a wrong entry is cancelled by a supervisor and posted again.
correction.journalUntouched: Neither act touches what a till has already taken — the journal below is unchanged by a write-off, and a receipt already in a collector's hands is never retro-voided.
correction.reasonHint: Up to {{max}} characters. It is kept beside the correction in this branch's history, and read by whoever asks about this entry months from now.
correction.dismiss: Read it — show me what I can do

cancel.why: Nothing has been taken against entry {{number}}, so all {{amount}} of it can be withdrawn as though it never happened.
cancel.whyTheft: Entry {{number}} is an approved theft of {{amount}}. Nothing consumes a theft, so there is no remainder to write off. Cancelling it withdraws the theft, and its business day goes back to showing its cash variance.

supervisorOnly.cancel: Nothing has been taken against entry {{number}}, so all {{amount}} of it can still be withdrawn — but only by an accountant supervisor. If it was posted wrongly, ask one to cancel it, then post the right entry.
supervisorOnly.writeOff: A till has already taken part of entry {{number}} — {{remaining}} of {{amount}} is left. Only an accountant supervisor can write off the remainder; ask one if it should not be kept.
supervisorOnly.cancelTheft: Entry {{number}} is an approved theft of {{amount}}. Only an accountant supervisor can cancel it; if it was posted wrongly, ask one to cancel it, and its business day goes back to showing its cash variance.

writeOff.why: A till has already taken part of entry {{number}} — {{remaining}} of {{amount}} is left. It cannot be cancelled, because what a till took is on a document the branch already acted on. The remainder can be written off instead.

none.consumed: A till has taken all of this entry. There is nothing left to cancel or write off — it is finished, and its journal below says where the money went.
none.cancelled: This entry was cancelled. Nothing had been taken against it, so it was withdrawn as though it never happened, and it is not corrected twice.
none.written-off: This entry's remainder was already written off. What a till took before that is unchanged, and an entry is not corrected twice.
none.nothing-left: This entry has nothing left on it, so there is nothing to cancel or to write off.
none.pending: This entry waits for a supervisor’s approval. It is not live yet, so there is nothing to cancel or write off — a supervisor approves it or rejects it.
none.rejected: A supervisor rejected this entry. It never went live, so there is nothing to cancel or write off.

raced.partlyConsumed: A till consumed part of this entry while this was open — {{remaining}} is left, not {{amount}}. It can no longer be cancelled as though it never happened. Write off the rest instead?
raced.nothingLeft: A till consumed all of entry {{number}} while this was open. There is nothing left to cancel or to write off — the entry is finished, and the journal below shows what took it.
raced.refused: The server would not cancel this entry, and its remaining has not changed. Read the journal below before deciding what to do next.
raced.closeOutRefused: The remainder was not written off. The server says {{remaining}} is what this entry now has left — read the journal below before deciding what to do next.
raced.closeOutUnstated: The remainder was not written off, and the server did not say what this entry now has left. Read the journal below before deciding what to do next.

done.writtenOff: Entry {{number}}'s remainder is written off. What a till already took is unchanged.

errors.cancelFailed: The cancellation could not be sent.
errors.closeOutFailed: The write-off could not be sent.
errors.forbidden: Only an accountant supervisor can cancel an entry or write off its remainder, and this session does not hold settlement supervision — nothing was changed.

mark.label: Change waiting
mark.title: A change request is waiting on this entry. Open the entry to see what is asked.

changeRequest.title: Change request
changeRequest.unavailable: Change requests are not available yet — this server does not offer them. Nothing else on this entry is affected.
changeRequest.unstated: This entry's change requests could not be read in full, so no change can be asked for here yet.
changeRequest.readOnly: Asking for a change needs the settlement grant, which this session does not hold.

finished.cancelled: This entry was cancelled. A finished entry is never changed, so no change can be asked for.
finished.written-off: This entry's remainder was written off. A finished entry is never changed, so no change can be asked for.
finished.rejected: A supervisor rejected this entry. A finished entry is never changed, so no change can be asked for — post a corrected entry instead.

ask.why: If entry {{number}}'s amount or Description is wrong, ask for a change. A supervisor approves or rejects it; until then the entry keeps working at its current figures.
ask.whyNow: If entry {{number}}'s amount or Description is wrong, change it here. A change you make as an accountant supervisor applies to the entry at once — there is no approval step.

remove.spent: The branch has spent {{spent}} from this entry, so it cannot be deleted.

deleteForm.intro: Ask a supervisor to delete entry {{number}}. Once approved, the entry is cancelled: it keeps its number and its history, and nothing more can be spent from it. Until then it keeps working at its current figures.
deleteForm.introNow: Deleting cancels entry {{number}}: it keeps its number and its history, and nothing more can be spent from it.
deleteForm.appliesNow: Applies immediately — no approval step. Entry {{number}} is cancelled the moment you confirm below.
deleteForm.reasonHint: Why this entry should be deleted — the supervisor reads it before deciding. Up to {{max}} characters.
deleteForm.reasonHintNow: Why this entry is deleted — it is kept in the entry's history. Up to {{max}} characters.

amount.label: Amount
amount.floor: Lowest allowed: {{floor}} — what the branch has already spent from this entry.
amount.invalid: Type an amount greater than zero.
amount.below-floor: The branch has already spent {{floor}} from this entry, so the amount cannot go below it.

description.label: Description
description.hint: The entry's own text, which the branch reads. Up to {{max}} characters.
description.too-long: The Description can be at most {{max}} characters.

reason.label: Reason
reason.hint: Why this change is asked for — the supervisor reads it before deciding. Up to {{max}} characters.
reason.hintNow: Why this change is made — it is kept in the entry's history. Up to {{max}} characters.

form.unchanged: Nothing differs from the entry yet. Change the amount or the Description to ask for a change.
form.appliesNow: Applies immediately — no approval step. Entry {{number}} is changed the moment you confirm below.

waiting.CHANGE: A change request is waiting on entry {{number}}.
waiting.DELETE: A request to delete entry {{number}} is waiting.

card.live: Entry {{number}} keeps working at its current figures until this request is decided.
card.withdrawHint: You raised this change request, so you can withdraw it before a supervisor decides it.
card.spentNow: Today the branch has spent {{spent}} from entry {{number}}, which stands at {{amount}}.
card.spentUnstated: What the branch has spent from entry {{number}} today could not be read. The server still checks it when you approve.
card.decideHint: Approving applies this to entry {{number}} at once. Rejecting leaves the entry as it is.

reason.label: Reason
reason.hint: Why this change request is rejected — the person who raised it reads it. Up to {{max}} characters.

reject.submit: Reject the change request on entry {{number}}

step.reject: It is still waiting. Reject it with a Reason; a fresh request can then be raised against the entry as it stands now.
step.decideFirst: Approve or reject it below first. Your own change or delete on entry {{number}} can be made once it is decided.

refusal.ENTRY_NOT_OPEN: Entry {{number}} no longer exists on the server, so nothing can be asked for or decided on it.
refusal.ENTRY_FINAL: Entry {{number}} was cancelled, written off or rejected meanwhile. A finished entry is never changed, so it is shown as it stands now.

BELOW_SPENT.figure: The branch has spent {{spent}} from entry {{number}}, so its amount cannot go below {{spent}}.
BELOW_SPENT.unstated: The branch has spent more from entry {{number}} than the amount asked for, so it cannot go that low.

DELETE_SPENT.figure: The branch has spent {{spent}} from entry {{number}}, so it cannot be deleted.
DELETE_SPENT.unstated: The branch has spent from entry {{number}}, so it cannot be deleted.

CHANGE_ALREADY_OPEN.named: A change request is already waiting on entry {{number}}. It is decided or withdrawn before another can be raised.
CHANGE_ALREADY_OPEN.unnamed: Another change request on entry {{number}} was raised at the same moment. Its change requests are being read again.

refusal.NO_CHANGE: Nothing would change — what is asked for is what entry {{number}} already holds.
refusal.CHANGE_STALE: Entry {{number}} has moved on since this was asked, so it cannot be applied as asked.

CHANGE_NOT_OPEN.APPLIED: This change request was already applied.
CHANGE_NOT_OPEN.REJECTED: This change request was already rejected.
CHANGE_NOT_OPEN.WITHDRAWN: This change request was already withdrawn by the person who raised it.
CHANGE_NOT_OPEN.SUPERSEDED: This change request was superseded by a supervisor's direct act on the entry.
CHANGE_NOT_OPEN.unsaid: This change request is no longer waiting — it was decided already, or no longer exists.

refusal.NOT_REQUESTER: Only the person who raised this change request can withdraw it. It stays waiting for a supervisor to approve or reject.
refusal.THEFT_DAY_COLLECTED: This theft's business day — or the day it would move to — has been collected, so it can no longer be corrected or deleted.
refusal.tracer: The change request was refused ({{code}}). Read the entry again, and report the code if it repeats.
refusal.unknown: The change request was refused. The server answered {{code}}.
refusal.unstated: The change request was refused, and the server did not say why.

invalid.SettlementAmountRequired: Type an amount greater than zero.
invalid.SettlementAmountRoundsToZero: This amount rounds to nothing in the branch's currency. Type a larger amount.

SettlementReasonTooLong.reason: The Reason is over {{max}} characters as the server counts them. Shorten it.
SettlementReasonTooLong.either: The Reason or the Description is over {{max}} characters as the server counts them. Shorten the longer one.

invalid.SettlementChangeReasonRequired: A Reason is required — the supervisor reads it before deciding.
invalid.SettlementDeleteTakesNoFigures: A delete names no amount, Description or day, and this one did. Nothing was done.
invalid.SettlementBusinessDayTheftOnly: Only a theft has a business day to move. Nothing was done.
invalid.SettlementTheftDayNotClosed: That day is not a closed day of this branch. Pick a day the branch traded and closed.
invalid.SettlementChangeBodyRequired: The server received an empty request, so nothing was done. Try again.
invalid.SettlementEntryRequired: The server was not told which entry this is about, so nothing was done. Open the entry again and retry.
invalid.SettlementChangeRequestRequired: The server was not told which change request this is about, so nothing was done. Open the entry again and retry.
invalid.SettlementChangeRequestKindInvalid: The server did not recognise the kind of request, so nothing was done.
invalid.SettlementRejectReasonRequired: A Reason is required to reject — the accountant reads it.

done.withdrawn: Your change request on entry {{number}} was withdrawn.
done.approved: The change request on entry {{number}} was approved and applied.
done.rejected: The change request on entry {{number}} was rejected. The entry is unchanged.

errors.loadFailed: This entry's change requests could not be read.
errors.readForbidden: This session no longer holds the settlement grant, so this entry's change requests cannot be read.
errors.raiseFailed: The change request could not be sent.
errors.forbidden: This session no longer holds the settlement grant — the change request was not raised.
errors.withdrawFailed: The change request could not be withdrawn.
errors.withdrawForbidden: This session no longer holds the settlement grant — the change request was not withdrawn.
errors.withdrawUnconfirmed: The server accepted the withdrawal but did not confirm the request was withdrawn. This entry's change requests are being read again.
errors.approveFailed: The change request could not be approved.
errors.rejectFailed: The change request could not be rejected.
errors.decideForbidden: You no longer hold settlement supervision, so this change request was not decided. Ask an administrator if you should.
errors.approveUnconfirmed: The server accepted the approval but did not confirm the request was applied. This entry's change requests are being read again.
errors.rejectUnconfirmed: The server accepted the rejection but did not confirm the request was rejected. This entry's change requests are being read again.

audit.title: Everything that has happened to this entry
audit.localTime: Times are the branch's own local clock, as the server wrote them — nothing on this pane is converted, and nothing is read from the administration audit, whose times are UTC.

post.openForBranch: Post an entry on this branch
post.title: Post a settlement entry

SHORTAGE.consequence: The branch must hand this money over

SURPLUS.consequence: The branch may keep this money back

THEFT.consequence: Money was stolen on one business day

branch.label: Which branch
branch.placeholder: Code, name in either script, or city — e.g. 0142, الروضة, Al-Rawdah, Riyadh
branch.unavailable: The estate could not be loaded, so no branch can be resolved and nothing can be posted. Try again in a moment.
branch.ambiguous: {{count}} branches match that. Nothing can be posted until exactly one does — pick one, or type the branch code.
branch.none: No branch matches that. Nothing can be posted until exactly one does.

standing.loading: Reading what this branch already carries…
standing.unknown: This branch's account could not be read, so what it already carries is unknown. Open the account before you commit.
standing.capped: This branch's account came back at the server's row limit, so what it already carries cannot be read in full here. Open the account before you commit.

clear.SHORTAGE: This branch carries no open shortage today.
clear.SURPLUS: This branch carries no open surplus today.

warning.SHORTAGE_one: This branch already carries {{total}} on an open shortage.
warning.SHORTAGE_other: This branch already carries {{total}} across {{count}} open shortages.
warning.SURPLUS_one: This branch may already keep back {{total}} on an open surplus.
warning.SURPLUS_other: This branch may already keep back {{total}} across {{count}} open surpluses.

standing.permitted: Posting another is allowed, and sometimes right — a genuine second one months later is a real entry. Check only that this is not the same one twice.

amount.label: Amount
amount.hint: Type an amount greater than zero. A grouping comma is fine.
amount.tooSmall: That figure rounds to nothing the ledger can hold, so no till could take it or hand it over.
amount.needsBranch: Name a branch first — the amount is counted in that branch's own currency.

reason.label: Description (the branch reads this at the till)
reason.hint: {{used}} of {{max}} characters. It prints on the branch's papers and is read there word for word, so every entry needs one.
reason.required: Write a description. It prints on the branch's papers, so no entry is posted without one.
reason.tooLong: Shorten the description to {{max}} characters. The branch's papers hold no more.
reason.previewEmpty: Nothing yet — a branch manager reading this at 23:00 has only these words to go on.

consequence.THEFT: A theft at {{store}} {{storeName}} on business day {{day}}. It moves no cash.

review.immutable: Once posted, this amount cannot be changed. An accountant supervisor can only cancel it while nothing has been taken against it, or write off its remainder once a till has taken part of it.
review.immutableTheft: Once posted, this amount cannot be changed. A theft waits for an accountant supervisor’s approval unless a supervisor posts it, and once it is approved only a supervisor can cancel it.

summary.THEFT: A theft of {{amount}} {{currency}} at {{store}} {{storeName}} on business day {{day}}.

done.adjusted: The server stored {{stored}} {{currency}}, not the {{reviewed}} that was reviewed. The figure above is the one on the ledger and the one the branch will be asked for.
done.immutable: Quote this number to the branch. The amount cannot be changed from here — an accountant supervisor can only cancel it while untouched, or write off its remainder once a till has taken part of it.
done.pending: This surplus waits for an accountant supervisor’s approval. No till can see it, and the branch cannot keep it back, until it is approved.
done.pendingTheft: This theft waits for an accountant supervisor’s approval. Until it is approved, the day keeps its cash variance.
done.immutableTheft: Quote this number when the theft is asked about. The amount cannot be changed from here — a waiting theft is approved or rejected by a supervisor, and an approved one can only be cancelled by a supervisor.

errors.failed: The entry could not be posted.

theft.dayHint: The day the money went missing. It must be a closed business day of this branch.
theft.dayRequired: Choose the business day the theft happened on. A theft is not posted without one.
theft.dayUnreadable: That is not a calendar date.
theft.note: A theft posted by an accountant always waits for an accountant supervisor’s approval, whatever its amount. It moves no cash: the branch hands nothing over and keeps nothing back.

kind.legend: What every row in this file does
kind.oneKindPerFile: One kind per file. The sheet has no kind column — a file mixing the two would make the total below a net figure a typo could hide inside.

file.label: The sheet finance produced
file.hint: An .xlsx or a .csv. Columns are read by their names, so a re-ordered sheet still posts.
file.reading: Sending the file and reading it back…
file.serverParses: Nothing is read here — the file goes up as it is and every figure below comes back from the server's own reading of it.

template.title: What the sheet has to contain

columns.StoreCode: the branch's code, exactly as it is spelled on the branch
columns.Amount: a plain number — no thousands separator and no currency symbol
columns.Reason: the description, up to 200 characters, printed on the branch's papers and read there word for word. A row without one is refused.

template.hint: Opens in Excel. Keep the first row of column names, replace the two EXAMPLE rows with the month's own, and save as .xlsx or .csv. The example rows name no branch, so a sheet uploaded with them still in it is refused rather than posted.

review.blocked: Nothing in this file can be posted until {{count}} of these are fixed in the sheet. Fix them, save, and upload it again.
review.unresolved: Row {{row}} — no branch has the code {{code}}, so this row cannot be posted onto anything.
review.warned: {{count}} rows carry a warning. They post: a branch that already carries an open entry of this kind can genuinely carry a second one, and this door is never stricter than the single form.
review.disagree: The server's own total for this file is {{server}}, and the rows below add up to {{rows}}. The rows are what will be posted. Read both before committing.
review.noCurrency: {{count}} of these rows came back without a currency, so the figure above is read at two decimals. Open one of those branches before committing.
review.totalHint: The figure above is the sum of the {{count}} rows in the grid — read the sentence, not the digits.
review.refusedHint: The file on disk is not the one that was previewed. Preview it again to see what changed before anything is posted.
review.awaiting_one: 1 row will wait for a supervisor’s approval before any till sees it. It still posts with the file.
review.awaiting_other: {{count}} rows will wait for a supervisor’s approval before any till sees them. They still post with the file.

done.replayed: This exact file had already been committed, so nothing was doubled — these are the entries it posted the first time.
done.immutable: These amounts cannot be changed. An accountant supervisor can cancel each while nothing has been taken against it, or write off its remainder once a till has taken part of it — and can withdraw the whole batch as one act.
done.withdrawSupervisor: If this file was wrong, only an accountant supervisor can withdraw the batch. Send them its withdrawal address:

errors.previewFailed: The file could not be read.
errors.commitRefused: This file was not posted. It no longer matches the one that was previewed.
errors.rowErrors_one: This file was not posted: the server refused 1 row, named in the grid. Fix the sheet and upload it again.
errors.rowErrors_other: This file was not posted: the server refused {{count}} rows, named in the grid. Fix the sheet and upload it again.
errors.fileRefused: This file was not posted: the server refused the file itself, as said above the grid. Fix the sheet and upload it again.
errors.commitFailed: This file was not posted, and the server did not say why. Preview it again before trying anything else.

batch.title: Withdraw an uploaded batch
batch.supervisorOnly: Withdrawing a batch is an accountant supervisor's act, so nothing can be withdrawn from this session. If finance sent the wrong file, send this page's address to a supervisor.

errors.withdrawFailed: The batch could not be withdrawn.
errors.forbidden: Only an accountant supervisor can withdraw a batch, and this session does not hold settlement supervision — nothing was withdrawn.

act.notRetroVoided: What a till has already taken is untouched by this: a receipt in a collector's hands is never retro-voided, and an entry a till reached first keeps its remainder until you write it off on its own account.
act.reasonLabel: Why (every withdrawn entry's audit reads this)
act.reasonHint: Up to {{max}} characters. It is filed against each entry this act withdraws — "finance sent the wrong file" is the sentence this box is for.
act.wholeBatch: Withdraw every entry this batch posted. Entries a till has already spent are refused and named.

outcome.refused: A till got to these first ({{count}})
outcome.refusedRow: Not withdrawn — {{remaining}} is what it now has left. {{reason}}
outcome.refusedRowUnstated: Not withdrawn — {{remaining}} is what it now has left, and the server did not say why.
outcome.pendingRow: Not withdrawn — no till has seen it, and it still waits for approval. Open its account to reject it (a rejection needs a reason).
outcome.rejectedRow: Not withdrawn — a supervisor had already rejected it, so it never went live and there is nothing on it to settle.

figures.notActionable: A report figure. The estate's total is nobody's to settle and no till can consume it — a position belongs to one branch, on its own account.

ledger.title: Entries across the estate
ledger.subtitle: Look up an entry by its number, or list what a branch, a kind or a date range holds. No position is stated here — an entry is acted on from its own branch's account.
ledger.prompt: Ask for something: an entry number, or a kind, a status or a date range below. There is no unfiltered list, because a capped one would look like the whole ledger.
ledger.empty: Nothing matches that. Check the entry number — the handle a branch quotes is the one minted at posting, not the branch code.
ledger.showing: {{count}} entries. Open one to act on it.
ledger.capReached: This reached {{limit}} entries, so there may be more. Narrow it by branch, kind, status or date.

entry.label: Entry number
entry.placeholder: Entry number — the handle a branch quotes on the phone

errors.lookupFailed: The lookup could not be completed.

open.title: Open settlements
open.subtitle: Every entry the estate still has open, oldest first. How long one has been open is stated here as a fact — nothing on this screen decides when an entry is late.
open.subtitleUnordered: Every entry the estate still has open, in the order the server sent them. It is not sending ages yet, so nothing here says how long one has been open — or which of them is the oldest.
open.subtitleCash: Every special receipt a branch has prepared and nobody has collected, oldest first. How long one has been waiting is stated here as a fact — nothing on this screen decides when a receipt is late.
open.loadingCash: Loading the receipts nobody has collected…
open.capReached: This reached {{limit}} entries, so there may be more. The oldest are first, so anything missing is newer than what is here.
open.capReachedUnordered: This reached {{limit}} entries, so there may be more. Ages are not being sent yet, so there is nothing to say about which ones are missing.
open.capReachedCash: This reached {{limit}} waiting receipts, so there may be more. That is far more than collection normally leaves behind — tell head office, and expect this list to be incomplete.
open.unranked: The server did not say which of these branches are yours, or how long each has been open, so this is one list in the order it arrived.

signpost.olderThanYours: oldest is {{oldest}} — older than anything of yours ({{yours}})

chase.title: Record a chase
chase.aboutUnassigned: About entry {{entryNumber}} · nobody is assigned to this branch
chase.internalHint: Internal — the branch never reads this. Notes cannot be edited or deleted; add another to correct one.
chase.failed: The note could not be saved.

owing.title: No open shortage.
owing.hint: No branch has a shortage left to hand over.

owed.title: No open surplus.
owed.hint: No branch has a surplus left to keep back.

theft.title: No approved theft.
theft.hint: No branch has an approved theft on its account. One that still waits for a supervisor is under Awaiting approval.

cash.title: No cash waiting.
cash.hint: Every prepared receipt has been collected.

pending.title: Nothing waiting for approval.
pending.hint: Every large surplus and every theft posted has been approved or rejected.

filtered.title: Nothing matches these filters.
filtered.hint: Clear a filter to see the rest of the estate.

errors.laneFailed: This list could not be read, so nothing can be said about what the estate has open. This is not “nothing to do” — try again, and tell head office if it keeps happening.
errors.cashFailed: The waiting receipts could not be read, so nothing can be said about what is sitting uncollected. This is not “everything has been collected” — try again, and tell head office if it keeps happening.
errors.pendingFailed: The entries waiting for approval could not be read, so nothing can be said about what is waiting. This is not an empty queue.

open.subtitlePending: Every entry in the estate that waits for an accountant supervisor — a large surplus, or a theft of any amount — oldest first. None of them is open, and no till can see them until one is approved.
open.loadingPending: Loading the entries waiting for approval…
open.capReachedPending: Showing the first {{limit}} entries waiting for approval — there may be more. At this many, nobody is approving.
open.subtitlePendingUnordered: Every entry in the estate that waits for an accountant supervisor — a large surplus, or a theft of any amount — in the order the server sent them; it is not sending their age yet. None of them is open, and no till can see them until one is approved.
open.subtitleTheft: Every approved theft in the estate, with the business day it names. A theft moves no cash — nothing here is waiting to be collected or kept back, and nobody is rung about it.

panel.title: Supervisor approval
panel.waiting: Entry {{number}} waits for an accountant supervisor’s approval. No till can see it until then, and it is in none of this branch’s figures.
panel.rejectedNext: A rejected entry cannot be approved later. If the branch should still have a surplus, post a corrected entry.
panel.rejectedNextTheft: A rejected entry cannot be approved later. The day keeps its cash variance, and no shortage was posted for it. If the theft should still be recorded, post a corrected entry.

approve.title: Approve entry {{number}}
approve.explain: Approving makes this entry open now. The branch’s next shift close can keep this amount back.

reject.title: Reject entry {{number}}
reject.explain: Rejecting is final. No till will ever see this entry, and the accountant who posted it reads your reason.
reject.reasonHint: Required. The accountant reads this before posting a corrected entry. Up to {{max}} characters.

approval.decided: Entry {{number}} was no longer waiting — it is now {{status}}. Nothing was changed.
approval.gone: Entry {{number}} no longer exists. Nothing was changed.
approval.refused: Entry {{number}} was not changed. The server answered {{code}}.

errors.forbidden: You no longer hold settlement supervision, so this entry was not changed. Ask an administrator if you should.
errors.failed: The decision could not be sent. Nothing was changed.

theft.short: {{amount}} short — {{counted}} counted against {{system}} of system cash
theft.over: {{amount}} over — {{counted}} counted against {{system}} of system cash
theft.even: No variance — {{counted}} counted against {{system}} of system cash
theft.unstated: The server sent no cash figures for this day.
theft.failed: That day’s cash could not be read. It is information only — look the entry up on the ledger before deciding.
theft.judge: The amount is not capped by the day’s variance. Whether it is right is yours to judge.
theft.approveExplain: Approving records this theft against its business day. It moves no cash: no till takes it, and the branch hands nothing over and keeps nothing back.
theft.rejectExplain: Rejecting is final. The day keeps its cash variance, no shortage is posted for it, and the accountant who posted it reads your reason.
